thread:
natalie: Quick ask from SOC: Who is allowed to request SIEM snapshots older than 30d and what's the unwrap flow? Need one-paragraph guidance.

raj: Forensic-only requests. Only `security:siem_requester` role can open. `security:siem_viewer` is not granted until ephemeral unwrap.

emma: Flow (short): request -> oncall approval -> `gms-grant` issues ephemeral unwrap token -> export to temp S3 (SSE-KMS) -> ephemeral role assumes access. Token logged.

emma: Example gms-grant: `gms-grant --principal=security:siem_ephemeral --key=logs-cmk --ttl=2h --reason="INV-4521"` (save grant_id in ticket).

taylor: Storage rules: bucket uses same CMK, lifecycle delete after `retention_days`, bucket policy denies non-ephemeral principals. Default retention=14d.

ops-bot: audit:export_requested case=INV-4521 by=natalie

natalie: Ticket template (short):
```
requestor: <email>
case_id: <INV-#>
justification: <brief>
time_range: <start,end>
retention_days: <14>
kms_key: <logs-cmk-id>
approvers: <oncall_sec>
grant_id: <from gms-grant>
```

raj: Breakglass: allowed with 2-person auth (requestor + oncall), must notify CISO and log as breakglass; retro review within 24h.

emma: Extras: DLP check for PII on export, retain unwrap/audit logs 1y.

natalie: Thanks 44d3fb post PRs in #eng-security when ready.
